You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
[#9] AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then help you transfer those prescriptions. I verified your identity. I searched for a Harbor Pharmacy on Main in Lakeview, but I'm not finding that location. Can you give me the address or cross street so I can find the right store?
CALLER: Near Oak, that's the cross street I remember.
[#14] AGENT: Let me search for that. Got it—Harbor Pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview, near Oak. I found that store. However, I'm not seeing any active prescriptions in your record right now. Are your albuterol and sertraline currently at Brightway 4471, or have they already been filled elsewhere?
CALLER: Yeah they're at Brightway 4471 in Columbus, that's where I need 'em transferred from.
[#17] AGENT: I understand—they're at Brightway 4471 in Columbus. Since those prescriptions are at another pharmacy chain, not at Harbor, I can't transfer them directly. You'll need to call Brightway or ask the Harbor Pharmacy on Main in Lakeview to request the transfer from Brightway for you. When you contact Harbor, give them the store details: Brightway 4471 in Columbus, and the medications are albuterol and sertraline.
CALLER: Wait, so you can't just do it from your end? I gotta call them myself?
[#20] AGENT: Right, I can't initiate it from my end—that's how it works with other pharmacy chains. The receiving pharmacy, Harbor on Main in Lakeview, needs to call Brightway and request the transfer. So you can either call Harbor directly at that location and ask them to pull your prescriptions from Brightway, or call Brightway and ask them to send your albuterol and sertraline to Harbor on Main in Lakeview. Either way works.
CALLER: Alright, alright, I'll just call Harbor myself then. Thanks for finding the right one at least.
[#23] AGENT: You're welcome! Just to recap, that's Harbor Pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview, near Oak. Good luck with the transfer.
CALLER: I don't know the address, I just moved. Can't you just tell me which ones there are?
[#26] AGENT: Of course—there's just one Harbor Pharmacy in Lakeview, and it's at 2250 Main Street, near Oak Street. That's the one to call.
CALLER: Okay cool, that's the one near Oak so that's gotta be it. Thanks man, I'll give 'em a call.
[#29] AGENT: You got it. Good luck!
CALLER: Alright, thanks for the help, bye.
